title: Fire Extinguisher, Class ABC, UL Rating 4A:80B:C, Rechargeable, 10 lb capacity, 21 ft Range
description:
A fire extinguisher is a safety device designed to control or extinguish small fires in emergency situations. It consists of a handheld cylindrical pressure vessel containing an agent that can be discharged to suppress flames. Industry professionals use it as a first response tool before the fire department arrives, preventing minor incidents from escalating into major disasters.


The AMEREX - B456 is a fire extinguisher designed for industrial applications. It's classified as an ABC type, meaning it can combat fires involving common combustibles, flammable liquids, and electrical equipment. The extinguishing agent within the unit is Monoammonium Phosphate, a dry chemical substance known for its effectiveness in suppressing various types of fires. This model has a maximum discharge distance of 21 feet and can continuously release its firefighting agent for up to 20 seconds when activated.
